description: Long-life deaths for fateApprentice, following 'But it was in the #mentorTitle#'s employ that you met your fate.'
deathApprenticeLong: The #mentorTitle# guarded the secrets of the work jealously, and for forty years you served without once being permitted past the door of the inner laboratory. When at last the #mentorTitle# died, you broke the seals with trembling, spotted hands, and what you found within stopped your old heart before the night was out. You were discovered the next morning among the #mentorTitle#'s papers, your face fixed in #moodNegative# wonder.
